name: warden
description: KOZMOS Warden: a guard for destructive shell commands. Before Claude or a subagent runs rm -rf on a broad path, git push --force, reset --hard, clean -fd, DROP TABLE, mkfs, format, curl | sh and their kin, warden asks you (Allow once / Deny) and refuses when no one can answer. A band flashes for 8 s after a block; /warden lists the rules and this session's log.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: ask: ask you before a risky command (deny when no one can answer); deny: refuse every risky command; warn: let it run and only flash a warning.

extraPatterns.title: Extra patterns
extraPatterns.description: Your own risky-command regexes (case-insensitive), separated by ;; — for example: kubectl delete ;; terraform destroy
